input.prompt: Repaint this exact scene in the same gouache Saturday-morning-cartoon painting style, same orange and purple sunset canyon, same brushwork, but as a wide 16:9 frame. The open treasure chest full of gold coins still teeters on the cliff edge on the right. New: from the upper left, a long rickety wooden chute pours a thick stream of shiny gold coins into the chest; near the bottom of the chute a much thinner stream of coins splits off into a small wooden bucket standing on the rock near the signpost. The wooden signpost on the left keeps its three boards, completely blank. The brass plate on the chest is blank. Leave calm sky space in the upper middle. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
